name: APEX Signature
description:
APEX Signature allows you to capture signatures through multiple methods: drawing, image upload, or webcam capture. Save the resulting image into your database.

Version 3.0.0 New Features:

  • Multi-Input Capture: Draw, Upload, or Webcam modes
  • Tab interface for switching between capture modes
  • Drag-and-drop image upload support
  • Webcam capture with live video preview
  • New CSS file for styling with Universal Theme support
  • Dark mode compatible
  • New Dynamic Action events for all capture modes
  • New JavaScript API: getMode(), setMode()

Version 2.0.1 Bug Fixes:

  • Fixed Issue #20/#21: Dynamic Action events now fire correctly
  • Added Page Items to Submit support (Issue #13)

Version 2.0.0 Updates:

  • Updated signature_pad library to v5.0.4
  • Pointer Events API for touch/stylus
  • Oracle 23ai and APEX 24.2 compatibility
